period_note: SOLO/SEPARATE basis ('Condensed Balance Sheet'/'Condensed Profit & Loss Account' headed 'Eastern Bank PLC.'). Per project-wide convention, this Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing is the Q2 data point. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2024 (column header '01 January 2024 to 30 June 2024'). SEASONAL PATTERN CONFIRMED: paid-up capital jumped from 12,072m (as of 2024_Q1.json / 31-Dec-2023) to 13,581m here, i.e. the FY2023 bonus share issue and cash dividend were processed during this quarter (Apr-Jun 2024) — the same AGM-timing pattern later seen in 2025_Q2.json (FY2024 bonus, Apr-Jun 2025) and 2026_Q2.json (FY2025 bonus, Apr-Jun 2026): EBL consistently issues bonus shares and pays cash dividends in Q2, three years running. Worth a project insights.json entry. RESTATEMENT/DISCREPANCY CARRIED FORWARD from 2024_Q1.json: this filing's 31-Dec-2023 Solo comparative again shows total_equity = BDT 39,767m, total_assets = BDT 508,554m and fixed_assets = BDT 8,517m — identical to the Q1 2024 filing's comparative (confirming that filing's figures, not a transcription error), but still diverging from bank_financials/EBL/quarterly/2023_Q4.json (total_equity 37,484m, total_assets 506,271m, fixed_assets 5,994m). See 2024_Q1.json for full detail; not re-derived or reconciled here, and no historical file was edited.
